description: The pie chart compares the proportions of two categories related to a specific aspect of the "Paper Copilot" system. The chart is divided into two slices, representing "Reduction" and "Efficient deployment". The "Reduction" slice is colored brown and occupies approximately 69.92% of the chart, while the "Efficient deployment" slice is colored blue and accounts for around 30.08%. Both slices are labeled with their corresponding percentages and numerical values (60.9s and 26.2s, respectively). The chart does not include a legend, and the percentage labels are displayed inside the slices. The slices are not visually emphasized or ordered in a particular way.
